hero.name: Varun Satapathy
hero.bio: Crafting digital realms where logic meets creativity. I build immersive games and high-performance web applications.

about.title: About Me
about.description: Hey there! I'm Varun, a fellow with a simple passion. I love to bring an 'immersive experience' through my coding. Every project I make, is made to pull the player into the world of the game by fine tuning what they percieve. I make experiences, solve problems, create solutions, all through coding. Let me know if our interests align!

projects.title: Wizard Wander
projects.description: A 2D infinite runner, where you control a wizard that jumps over obstacles, onto new platforms, and avoids & kills enemies. Made for Android

projects.title: Dungeon Duels
projects.description: A 2D battle game, where you and your friend, play on the same keyboard, to see who is the better fighter! The ultimate fight setter! Made for the Web

projects.title: Polarity Dash
projects.description: A 2D game in which, you control a ball that can switch polarity. Each polarity interacts differently with the environment. Reach the end of the level without dying to win! Made for the Web

projects.title: SyncSpace
projects.description: A cutting-edge team collaboration platform that seamlessly integrates real-time messaging, HD video conferencing, interactive polls, voice messages, AI-powered assistance, and comprehensive project management tools. Built with modern web technologies and designed for scalability, it empowers teams to communicate, collaborate, and stay productive from anywhere.

projects.title: LaunchPad
projects.description: A Web project that shows the working of the instrument 'launchpad'. It's mostly a mathematical, lighting simulation by pressing buttons and calculating boxes using matrices.

projects.title: Personal Music Player
projects.description: A Web-based music player made using my favourite songs of mid-2025! It features all the modern playback controls and a beautiful UI
